'''Avisio''' was a settlement on [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], a mining and agricultural colony. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] sent a newsfeed from there when they landed troops to protect the planet.
